_doc: P3255 (t823u/t824u/t834u): quiet bots. mode=quiet: triage allowed (labels, close, dedupe, edits, merges) + at most ONE consolidated reply per issue (marker, edited in place); new issues/PRs/status comments go to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. mode=silent: no issue/PR writes. Override with env BOT_MODE, or BOT_PUBLIC=1 for no filtering.
